# Замкнуть retryable analyses и потерянные DB→queue continuations

Source: [JSON](../../../phases/P3/P3.4.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Status

done

## Summary

Исправить A4 одним DB-backed recovery reconciler: retryable Running analyses после due получают повторную job, а Prepared/Screened transitions без следующего dispatch автоматически продолжаются либо явно терминализируются. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/artifacts-PARSING_PRODUCTION_ACCEPTANCE.json:138-160`).

## Why

`recordFailure()` оставляет retryable analysis Running, selector ждёт Failed; crash между state commit и Redis dispatch создаёт вечный orphan, который stuck-check только сообщает. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/artifacts-PARSING_PRODUCTION_AUDIT.json`, A4).

## Scope

```json
{
  "include": [

  ],
  "exclude": [
    "new external workflow engine; outbox unless a reproduced gap survives reconciler and a new D# admits it; retrying Unprocessable/permanent failures; dispatching extraction for non-extract dispositions."
  ]
}
```

## Rules

- Exactly one domain retry owner; selection and claim are atomic and honor `next_retry_at`, attempts, permanent flag, active version/run, analysis lease and feature flags. Recovery derives intended next stage from persisted state/result, never from missing queue evidence. Receivers remain idempotent. `afterCommit()` is ordering, not atomic dual-write proof. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/research-01-remediation-architecture.json`).

## Guidance

Build a state×stage×disposition dataset. Fault-inject after Prepared/run commit before screening dispatch and after Screened decision commit before extraction dispatch; run reconciler twice/concurrently and assert exactly one appropriate job, no double materialization. Use real transient ScreeningJob failure with time advance, not an artificially prebuilt Failed fixture. Retain/review/ignore must never dispatch extraction. Do not mark retryable work terminal merely to satisfy old selector.
